---
name: Share a visualization
about: Show what you made, or tell us what still needed work
labels: ''
---

## What did you make?
Describe the document, intended audience, agent, and rendering stack.

## What worked, and what needed manual changes?
Honest failures are useful. A star or positive review is not required.

## Example (optional)
Attach only public or redacted material you have permission to share. Do not upload customer data, credentials, or personal information.

## Reproduction (optional)
Include a minimal prompt and non-sensitive sample data.

## Permission to feature
By default, this issue is feedback only. We will ask before featuring your work or quoting you in promotional material.
